_entry_fsm_note: WalkRun-like fsm ids a take-over may start from. 505/801 are the ids wbc_nx/remote_start launches from on this robot, 500 is the SDK Start() id. 0 (ZeroTorque) and 1 (Damp) are ALWAYS refused. ./start.sh --entry-fsm N narrows this to one id.

oem_lowcmd_writer._note: BLOCKER until filled: in WalkRun the OEM motion service writes rt/lowcmd. The check lists the DDS writers it sees on rt/lowcmd (logs/runs/*/ready.json). When the OEM confirms in writing that these are its own service, set confirmed=true and expected_writers=<that count>; any other count blocks motion.
